selection_rule: 5 randomly ordered tasks per relation x K stratum, unique graph groups; root seed 20261002; no model outputs read
training_checkpoint: seed42 fixed for every learned method; validation-selected epoch
statistics_unit: base graph, average 3 rollout seeds; paired differences, bootstrap CI and Holm corrected contrasts
no_retry_policy: retain all invalid/failed episodes; no outcome-triggered retries
execution_design: Each unique (scene_id, rollout_seed_id, chosen_actor_index) is executed once. Selectors choosing the same actor reuse the same physical execution outcome.
reason: Controller receives only target actor and shared scene/settings, so this fixes execution realization for equal target commands and avoids redundant simulation.
denominator_reporting: 180 paired query/scene-seed outcomes per selector; separately report unique physical rollouts, 60 independent base-graph clusters, and shared execution outcomes. Do not label reused outcomes as additional physical runs.
equal_reference_policy: Oracle and semantic/fine-rank rule select the same actor for all 300 test tasks; report one execution-reference band.
